dedupe_keys.name: burkina faso ministry of energy mines and quarries half yearly statistical bulletin power plants capacity energy delivered and sold subscribers hydrocarbons and mining

description: Half-yearly statistical bulletin of Burkina Faso's Ministry of Energy, Mines and Quarries, produced by its directorate of sector studies and statistics (DGESS). The edition for the second half of 2025 (37 pages, file dated 28 April 2026) holds 48 tables and a set of charts with monthly figures for July to December: number of power plants in service by type (SONABEL thermal, hydroelectric, ABER thermal and hybrid, SONABEL and independent solar, private thermal, mini solar plants), cumulative installed capacity excluding solar (MW), installed solar capacity (MWc), new electricity subscribers, availability of the large thermal plants, energy delivered to distribution and sold by SONABEL (GWh), peak demand, solar backup kits installed, hydrocarbons, and for mining and quarries the valid titles, mines in production, employment, production and revenue. Sources named in the tables include SONABEL and ABER. Coverage: national, Burkina Faso; the first half of 2024 edition is also listed. Format and access: PDF in French, free download from the ministry's site. Licence: not stated. Caveats: tables are in PDF, so figures must be transcribed; editions are not listed for every half-year on the site. Simulation uses: capacity planning and resilience studies of a small West African grid that relies on thermal plants, imports and growing solar. Related records: compare with the GEM Global Integrated Power Tracker (data-gem-global-integrated-power-tracker) for plant-level data.
